units: Blender metres = glTF metres (Blender +Z up; glTF +Y up). Runtime world units = 2 x metres, +0.11 on Y. Percentages are signed (measured - target) / target against the stated target or the violated range bound. Gate: |deviation| <= 3.000% (render-gates.md:65); -3.077% fails.

method.measurement: Pure CPython/numpy on the frozen helper c7ce9d8e. Each vertex range is tagged by the exact helper source line that authored it, which separates sub-parts: shell vs cheeks vs knobs, rack frame vs stubs vs booms, sustain base vs cable, pad head vs rim vs lugs. Cross-checked against the frozen v02 GLB baa1a43b: all 18 rows have equal triangle counts and world AABBs within 1e-7 m. No Blender, no browser.
method.projection: A parameter-patched COPY of the helper in the scratchpad (never the repo) was rebuilt with the proposed values. Checks: tri-tri intersections against the frozen M3 v03 parent triangles; eye rays from Blender (-0.35, -1.70, 1.345); pinhole projections with the M1 builder cameras. Planning evidence only: ray samples and projected boxes are not rendered pixels or visual approval.
